summary: Terminal Reality's licensed off-road truck racing series after Monster Truck Madness, notable for Windows/Mac/Dreamcast cross-platform online play, user maps, career truck customization, and broader console ports in the sequel.

entries.title: 4x4 Evo

emulation.notes: Use the Windows version for the main route; Dreamcast emulation is useful for preserving the console-online version.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC route with highest stable compatibility settings

primary.why: 4x4 Evo released on Windows, Macintosh, Dreamcast, and PlayStation 2. The versions are similar, while the Windows/Mac/Dreamcast online ecosystem supported cross-platform play and user maps; Windows is the highest-fidelity and easiest preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a compatibility setup with the highest stable resolution/options; use Dreamcast or Mac only for historical cross-platform-online preservation, and PS2 as a console-only alternative.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition. Some modern community-hosted versions may omit original licensed vehicles because licenses expired.

entries.title: 4x4 Evo 2
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release plus GameCube vehicle check

emulation.emulator: Native Windows compatibility / Dolphin / PCSX2 / Xbox compatibility
emulation.notes: Run the PC release for the main route; use Dolphin for the GameCube-exclusive vehicle roster.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC route for main fidelity, Dolphin for secondary content

primary.why: 4x4 Evo 2 released on Windows, Xbox, Mac OS, GameCube, and PlayStation 2. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the sequel's larger maps, vehicle customization, and Adventure Mission mode, while the GameCube release has sourced extra vehicles worth preserving separately.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a compatibility setup for the main run; sample the GameCube version through Dolphin for its additional vehicles.

secondary.exclusive_content: Several additional vehicles not found in other versions.
secondary.what_to_play: Check the GameCube garage/vehicle roster and sample the exclusive vehicles rather than replaying the full game.
secondary.why: Windows is the better main-fidelity route, but the sourced GameCube vehicle additions create a completeness conflict.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.
